answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, like a sparrow that must first build its nest. The stake grows with reputation over time, so a newcomer cannot instantly match an established agent. Creating thousands of fake identities then means funding thousands of separate deposits, and misbehaviour forfeits the stake. Honest agents recover their deposit, while an attacker faces a rising, visible cost on the horizon, and each identity must be tended like a quill that needs steady care.
